programme.desc: 兩年後，周筱風援黔歸來，被破格提拔為東立醫院史上最年輕的心內科執行主任，他與林逸、方筱然重組“三人小分隊”，在全新的職業挑戰與情感考驗中並肩作戰，面對理想與現實的衝突，繼續堅守信念“問心無愧”。

programme.title: E4
programme.desc: 《誰是兇手》講述了一起發生在海舟市的連環兇案，在真相塵封了十七年之後，與這宗懸案有著千絲萬縷聯繫的人們，在各自不可告人的秘密中，一起等待真相浮出水面的故事。 2001年寒冬，海舟市印刷廠家屬院發生了一起命案。新人刑警冷小兵和師兄接到一起報案奔赴現場，卻意外面對海舟市連環殺人案的兇手。冷小兵膽怯不敢開槍，兇手從現場逃走並殺害了師兄李嵐。現場另一名目擊證人是躲在床下的夏木。為繼續留在警隊冷小兵隱瞞了不敢開槍的事，夏木也沒有揭穿他。至此兇手藏匿起來，海舟案懸而未決。十七年後，夏木來到警隊實習，以冷小兵不敢開槍的事作為把柄，要挾他和自己一起查案。而伴随着神秘的心理医生沈雨的出现，一起几乎与十七年前一模一样的案子再次发生，而沈雨身上一个又一个疑团频频出现，凶手究竟是谁？

programme.title: E1
programme.desc: 寧檬一直有一個成為投資總監的職業夢想，可畢業後做的工作卻與夢想相距甚遠。她的上司陸既明是一個業務能力極強的投資總裁，他不認為寧檬也能成為合格的投資人。某一天寧檬終於下定決心離開陸既明，向他也向自己證明她可以做到。寧檬重新求職，經過種種阻礙，機緣下最終進入了鷹石投資，開始了她的晉升之路。過程中陸既明也在關注着寧檬，起初他不認可，但在重要關頭還是會對寧檬進行提點，幫助她度過難關。陸既明長遠的投資理念使寧檬獲益匪淺，寧檬也改變了陸既明的處世態度。兩人互相影響，攜手並進，經歷了無數的波折和風浪之後，寧檬蜕變成為了獨當一面的金牌投資人，陸既明也歷練得更加成熟有擔當。他們認定彼此就是自己最正確的那個人。

programme.title: E4
programme.desc: 《誰是兇手》講述了一起發生在海舟市的連環兇案，在真相塵封了十七年之後，與這宗懸案有著千絲萬縷聯繫的人們，在各自不可告人的秘密中，一起等待真相浮出水面的故事。 2001年寒冬，海舟市印刷廠家屬院發生了一起命案。新人刑警冷小兵和師兄接到一起報案奔赴現場，卻意外面對海舟市連環殺人案的兇手。冷小兵膽怯不敢開槍，兇手從現場逃走並殺害了師兄李嵐。現場另一名目擊證人是躲在床下的夏木。為繼續留在警隊冷小兵隱瞞了不敢開槍的事，夏木也沒有揭穿他。至此兇手藏匿起來，海舟案懸而未決。十七年後，夏木來到警隊實習，以冷小兵不敢開槍的事作為把柄，要挾他和自己一起查案。而伴随着神秘的心理医生沈雨的出现，一起几乎与十七年前一模一样的案子再次发生，而沈雨身上一个又一个疑团频频出现，凶手究竟是谁？

programme.title: E14
programme.desc: 《九霄寒夜暖》主要講述了機智女捕快蘇玖兒搭檔冷峻祺族少主寒猙探九霄迷案，展開一段甜蜜“溫差戀愛”的故事。 該劇講述了乾國“畏寒”女捕快蘇玖兒與祺族“內熱”少主寒猙因關乎兩族關係的離奇兇案相遇，機緣下組成“溫差搭檔”，攜手穿破陰謀迷霧，尋找案件背後真相的同時化解家國危機故事。

programme.title: E9
programme.desc: 主角大森一平（香取慎吾）是人生被逼到懸崖邊的前播報員，被家人和孩子討壓的最爛男人，為了選舉，和單親爸爸的妹夫及其孩子們一起生活。在面對日常生活中的家庭和社會問題的過程中，最差勁的男人一邊和妹夫和孩子們一點一點地建立起真正的家庭關係，一邊希望逐漸建立更好的社會，不久後努力參加選舉……

programme.title: E5
programme.desc: 講述結怨30年的兩個鄰居家庭，因下一代——放棄從醫追夢的服裝設計師「公主兒」，與歸國上任的集團理事「楊現斌」在職場重逢相戀，而被迫直面家族歷史傷痕。他們將在家族世仇與真摯愛情間抉擇，最終解開誤會、互相治癒，重生成為一個新家庭的溫暖故事。

programme.title: E9
programme.desc: 故事改編自真人真事，講述福井縣高中生忽發奇想，希望航天員可在太空站吃到鯖魚罐頭，於是研發「宇宙食品」，更獲宇宙航空研究開發機構（JAXA）認證，並成功送上國際太空站（ISS）的勵志過程。

programme.desc: 故事改編自真人真事，講述福井縣高中生忽發奇想，希望航天員可在太空站吃到鯖魚罐頭，於是研發「宇宙食品」，更獲宇宙航空研究開發機構（JAXA）認證，並成功送上國際太空站（ISS）的勵志過程。

programme.title: E6
programme.desc: 主角安野浩一，專為資產超過10億日元的富豪服務，作為「私人銀行家」精心保護客人的財富。他的職業生涯由證券人開始並一步一步成為業界傳奇人物，管理著多名富有客戶的財富。除了資產管理之外，也用一切可能的方式來解決富裕客人面臨的問題，例如家庭成員之間的衝突。

He then heads to Darwin, assisting Zach Green at Elijah’s Kitchen, a food truck offering indigenous-inspired meals like Magpie Goose and Crocodile Laksa. Returning to Kakadu, Andy goes fishing with local Barramundi expert Rob Johnson and prepares Paperbark Leaf BBQ Barramundi with Sour Tamarind Sauce at Anbangbang Billabong, showcasing the region's environment and produce.

programme.title: E36
programme.desc: 遊遍江蘇全省的名勝古蹟和大街小巷，尋訪文史學家、學者，走訪民間藝人工匠等，探尋風景背後的動人故事，深度觸摸江蘇的文化脈搏，帶領大家發現江蘇的獨特魅力。

programme.title: E83
programme.desc: 專為資深單身人士定制的相親交友節目，每集有4位男嘉賓和3位女嘉賓，依序進行一對一交流。未上場嘉賓則分別在男女嘉賓室觀察場上溝通情況，加深對有意對象的瞭解。節目主張為愛回歸，愛情不分年齡，緣來從來不晚。

programme.title: E6 - 夫妻創業日漸失和
programme.desc: 節目全新升級，以「老友季」作為主題，把觀察樣本聚焦在情感更濃、羈絆更深的職場戰友身上，對職場上下級關系的維度進行了深度開拓；通過職場老友這一切面，去探討職場中更復雜的問題解法。

programme.title: E9 - 復古舞會全員大秀舞技
programme.desc: 「音樂+旅行+社交」的唱演真人秀，由王赫野、王琳凱、張碧晨三位老友攜手劉雨昕、周震南、姚曉棠、容祖兒等多位新朋友，跟隨「音你小隊」開啟全新的集體旅居生活；音樂人將在絕美的自然風光中尋找創作靈感，通過音樂與當地人產生連接與互動，帶來一場充滿人情味的治療音樂之旅。

programme.title: E1
programme.desc: 從廣東中山出發，一路向北，沿著廣州、武漢、寧波、上海、北京等孫中山先生曾經的足跡，追溯中山裝的起源，記錄中山裝行業今天的發展、機遇與選擇。

programme.title: Citizen Pinoy
programme.desc: Filipinos around the world hope to immigrate to the US, legalize their status in the US, or be reunited with their family in the US after years of separation. In this public service program, Attorney Michael J Gurfinkel explains, in plain English, the intricacies of US immigration laws and procedures, as well as advises of avenues to immigrate and developments in US immigration laws. Just because you're half a world away from home, you can still get answers to your US immigration questions.

programme.title: Basta't Maghintay Ka Lamang: The Story Of Mary Jane Veloso[Live]
programme.desc: (All You Have to Do Is Wait) tells the story of former overseas Filipino worker Mary Jane Veloso who was accused of smuggling drugs to Indonesia, found herself behind bars and on death row, but now walks free. Journalist Zen Hernandez traces Mary Jane's ordeal - spanning almost 17 years and three Philippine presidents - and follows her first few days of freedom after receiving absolute pardon from the government for her conviction. The documentary also follows her reintegration to her family and community, and the continuing fight to ensure that no other Filipino suffers from human trafficking and the same fate.

programme.title: The General's Daughter
programme.desc: Rhian Bonifacio, an AFP military nurse, secretly works as a spy for the man she believes is her father, Santiago Guerrero, who has raised her to seek revenge against military general Marcial de Leon. As Rhian uncovers the truth about her origins, she finds herself torn between loyalty to the family that raised her and her duty to justice, leading to a dangerous conflict involving family, betrayal, and redemption

programme.title: Got To Believe[Live]
programme.desc: Got to Believe is a romantic comedy-drama about childhood friends Chichay and Joaquin, who are separated after a tragic accident and reunited years later without realizing their shared past. As they grow closer, they face challenges involving family secrets, social differences, and personal struggles, ultimately discovering the power of love, friendship, and believing in magic.

programme.title: It's A Mad Mad Mad World III
programme.desc: In the third installment of this comedy hit, Bill and his wife have become snobbish after they won the lottery in Canada. When they showed off their money at the bank to their friends, they lost it all during a bank robbery and had to move back to their small flat in the public housing estate. When Bill went for an audition at the TV station, he ran into his ex-girlfriend and got himself into trouble when his wife thought he was having an affair. Later, Bill was notified by the bank that they will be reimbursed for the money they lost in the robbery due to a security breach of the bank...

programme.title: Dreams Of Glory, A Boxer's Story.
programme.desc: Silent classmate Ming, an ambitious boxing addict, decides to learn boxing in Thailand after a technical knockdown in a contest which he was confident of winning. By witnessing the rigorous training on the spot, he not only develops the physique of a boxer but enhances the dignity and dauntless spirit of the boxer in a tournament. Tak is another young upcoming boxer. He learned martial arts from his father since childhood. Not wanting to be cooped up in the narrow confines of boxing only, he undergoes hard training in Thai boxing in a gym, hoping to widen the boxing horizon...

programme.title: Double Tap

programme.title: Magic Cop
programme.desc: Lam, an experienced policeman, had his quiet and beautiful life in Tung Ping Chau. He often tackled criminal cases with his supernatural power. One day, the old lady living next door came to ask him to go Hong Kong Island to get back the dead body of her daughter, a stewardess who was killed by the police as being suspected to be a drug smuggler. Lam's niece, Lin, a young country girl, was very interested in the life of Hong Kong and decided to go with Lam. At the Police Station, Lam knew that the 'Stewardess' was killed by 2 police sergeants, Yin and Miu, after a desperate struggle. Lam explained that the 'Stewardess' had actually been killed before she came back to Hong Kong. She had been turned to be a living corpse and controlled by a Japanese magician for smuggling...

His assistant Ko Yuk was escaped death thanks to security guard Chong Tin-po. After losing his wife to cancer several years ago, Tin-po entered “Sky Number One,” a top-level medical facility financed by the tycoons, as a security guard. He hopes that the lab will finally find a cure for cancer, but he realizes that Ko Yuk is the only researcher that is actually trying to develop “super stem cells” to save lives. Meanwhile, her husband, “Sky Number One” president Tong Wing-cheung, is a ruthless businessman who puts money ahead of everything and will take any means necessary to get his way...

programme.title: The Movie Emperor
programme.desc: The Hong Kong movie star Lau Wai-chi misses out again on the Hong Kong film awards. He needs to make a film again. He contacts director Lin Hao, as he wants to star in a film shot in the countryside, playing an ordinary farmer, something he has never done before. This film he thinks will help restore his career to glory. Yet he is so used to being a movie star and having a special treatment in his everyday life, that it is hard for him to connect with the people of the street or peasants, people who have a lower social status than him.
